Controller

RC radio or sim dongle: plug it in by USB and choose “USB Joystick (HID)” on the radio (EdgeTX / OpenTX / Ethos). Move a stick so the browser sees it, then press Choose your controls and move or press whatever you want for each function. Xbox controller: works straight away (left stick throttle, centre = hover); choose your controls to put any function on any stick, trigger, bumper, d-pad or button. It keeps its own setup, separate from your radio. Gamepad shortcut buttons are ignored for radios so switches don't trigger them.

W / SThrottle up / down (released = hover) A / DYaw ↑ ↓ ← →Pitch / roll BoostOff by default (Super boost setting). When on: top 5% of the throttle stick = super boost (Shift / Space on keyboard), and gold orbs refill it F / clickFire (Dogfight). Guns follow the FPV camera; auto-fire shoots when the crosshair is on a target CCamera: FPV → chase → ball cam (enemy cam in Dogfight) MToggle Acro / Angle (keyboard players: try Angle) RReset your drone (Freeplay only) · Esc menu · T mod panel EFlip back over. Pop: touch the ball with the top of your quad, inside the four motors (a faint white ring flashes, the dial shows POP for 5 s), then hold a direction (roll, pitch or yaw) and press E for a locked flip that way. Where the ball sits on you decides the pop GamepadMode 2 sticks. Xbox: RT fire, B flip over, LB camera, Y reset (Freeplay), Menu pause. Every button can be remapped in the Controls tab

    Current tune

    Calibration Laba training pack that tunes your rates while you fly

    Six short drills, each measuring one thing. Every overshoot, undershoot and wobble is measured and weighted by how big it was; the tuner adjusts your rates, deadband, throttle curve and assist as you go, so you feel the improvement within the same drill. Flies in Acro. Esc pauses.
